m: सं-√ खाद् P. -खादति, to chew thoroughly, eat up, devour, consume, ŚrS.; Mṛcch.
सं-खादक m. ‘chewer’, a tooth, Pat., Sch.
सं-˚खादकिन् mfn. toothed, fanged (in reproach), Pat.
सं-√ खिद् P. -खिदति, to press or force together, RV.; TS.; to drag or tear away, ChUp.

सं-√ ख्या P. -ख्याति, to reckon or count up, sum up, enumerate, calculate, ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to estimate by (instr.), MBh.; Ā. (only aor. सं-अख्यत) to appear along with, be connected with, belong to (instr.), RV.; VS. : Caus. -ख्यापयति, to cause to be looked at or observed by (instr.), TS.; ŚBr.
सं-ख्या (आ), f., see below
सं-ख्या f. reckoning or summing up, numeration, calculation (ifc. = ‘numbered or reckoned among’), R.; Ragh.; Rājat.
a number, sum, total (ifc. ‘amounting to’), ŚBr. &c. &c.
a numeral, Prāt.; Pāṇ. &c.
(in gram.) number (as expressed by case terminations or personal t˚), Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 1
deliberation, reasoning, reflection, reason, intellect, MBh.; Kāv.
name, appellation (= आख्या), R.
a partic. high number, Buddh.
manner, MW.
(in geom.) a gnomon (for ascertaining the points of the compass), RāmRās.
a: संख्या — {c2c} P. 1 To count, enumerate, calculate, sum up; तावंत्येव च तत्त्वानि सांख्यैः संख्यायंते Ś. B. --2 Ved. To appear along with, be connected with.

संख्या — 1 Enumeration, reckoning, calculation; संख्यामिवैषां भ्रमरश्चकार R. 16. 47. --2 A number. --3 A numeral. --4 Sum. --5 Reason, understanding, intellect. --6 Deliberation, reflection. --7 Manner. --Comp. --धतिग, अतीत a. beyond number, innumerable, countless. --मात्रं mere numeration. --वाचक a. expressive of number. --(कः) a numeral. --समापनः an epithet of Śiva.

m: सं-ख्या˚ङ्क-बिन्दु (˚ख्याङ्क्˚), m. a cipher, Kāv.
सं-ख्या—शब्द m. a numeral, L.
सं-ख्या—शस् ind. in great numbers, BhP.
सं-ख्या—कौमुदी f. N. of wk.
संख्याक mfn. amounting to (ifc., e.g. सप्तति-स्˚, q.v.), Hariv.
सं-ख्या—लिपि f. a partic. mode of writing, Lalit.
सं-ख्या—मात्र n. the amount of MW.
mere numeration, ib.
सं-ख्या—मङ्गल-ग्रन्थि m. the auspicious ceremony of tying knots in a thread corresponding to the number of the past years of one's life, Uttarar.
सं-ख्या—मुष्ट्य्-अधिकरण-क्षेप m. N. of wk.
सं-ख्या—नामन् n. a numeral, Nir.
सं-˚ख्यान n. becoming seen, appearance, BhP.
reckoning up, enumeration, calculation, Kāṭh.; ŚrS.; MBh. &c.
a number, multitude, Hcat.
measurement, Hariv.; MārkP.
सं-ख्या—निदान-टीका f. N. of wk.
सं-ख्या—पद n. a numeral, VPrāt. (v.l.)
सं-ख्या—परिमाण-निबन्ध m. N. of a work on ceremonial law considered by number and measure (by Keśava Kavīndra).
सं-ख्या—परित्यक्त mfn. ‘deserted by numeration’, innumerable, Pañcat.
सं-ख्या—रत्न n. N. of wk.
सं-ख्या—रत्न-कोश m. N. of wk.
सं-ख्या—समापन m. N. of Śiva, MBh.
सं-ख्याता (आ), f. (scil. प्रहेलिका) a kind of riddle based on counting, Kāv. iii, 101
सं-ख्या˚तानुदेश m. a subsequent enumeration the members of which correspond successively to those of a previous one, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 7.
सं-ख्यात mfn. reckoned up, enumerated, numbered, counted, measured, AV. &c. &c.
estimated by, R.
considered (see comp.)
सं-ख्यात m. pl. N. of a people, VarBṛS.
सं-ख्यात n. number, multitude, BhP.
a: संख्यात — p. p. 1 Enumerated. --2 Calculated, reckoned up. --तं A number. --ता A kind of riddle.

m: सं-ख्या—तस् ind. from a number, MW.
सं-ख्यात—संख्येय mfn. one who has considered what is to be considered, Car.
सं-ख्या˚तिग (˚ख्यात्˚), mf(आ)n. ‘going beyond numeration’, innumerable, Bhartṛ.
सं-ख्या—वाचक mf(इका)n. expressive of number
सं-ख्या—वाचक m. a numeral, ib.
1. सं-ख्या—वत् mfn. having number, numbered, Vās.
possessing reason or intellect, intelligent, discriminating, ib.; Mcar.
2. सं-ख्या—वत् ind. like number, MW.
a: संख्यावत् — a. 1 Numbered. --2 Possessed of reason. --m. A learned man.

m: सं-ख्या˚वृत्ति-कर (˚ख्यावृ˚), mfn. ‘causing repetition of counting’, difficult to be counted, very numerous, Hariv.
सं-ख्या—विधान n. the making of a calculation, VarBṛS.
सं-ख्या—योग m. a partic. constellation (relating to the number of Nakṣatras in which a planet is situated), VarBṛS.
सं-ख्य mfn. counting up or over, reckoning or summing up, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 7, Sch. (ifc.; cf. गो-स्˚)
सं-ख्य m. N. of a man, Cat.
सं-ख्य n. conflict, battle, war (only in loc.; cf. Naigh. ii, 17), MBh.; Kāv.; Rājat.
a: संख्यं — War, battle, fight; संख्ये द्विषां वीररसं चकार Vikr. 1. 68, 70; Ve. 3. 25; Śi. 18. 70; Māl. 8. 9.

m: सं-˚ख्यक mfn. numbering, amounting to (ifc.; cf. सहस्र-स्˚).
a: संख्यक — a. (At the end of comp.) Numbering, amounting to; शतसंख्यका नराः &c.

m: सं-ख्य—ता f. numerableness, numeration, MW.
सं-ख्य—त्व n. numerableness, numeration, MW.
सं-ख्येय mfn. to be numbered or enumerated, definite in number, calculable, not numerous, Pāṇ.; MBh. (cf. अ-स्˚)
to be considered (see संख्यात-स्˚).
